description: A Git client inside VS Code: branches, commit graph, file status with line staging and diffs in one panel.
cmd.bitbucket.signOut: Disconnect from Bitbucket (Remove Saved API Token)
cmd.commit.reset: Reset Current Branch to This Commit…
view.repositories.welcome:
No Git repositories were found in this workspace.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
[Clone Repository](command:git.clone)
config.gitPath: Path to the git executable. When empty, the git used by the built-in Git extension is used. Can only be set in user settings.
config.history.showRemoteBranches: Show remote branches in the history.
config.history.showStashes: Show stashes in the commit graph.
config.history.pageSize: Number of commits loaded at a time.
config.history.dateFormat: `relative`, `absolute`, or a format string such as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`.
config.graph.colors: Lane colors of the commit graph. Theme color IDs (e.g. `charts.blue`) are also accepted.
config.fileStatus.layout: Show staged and unstaged files in two lists (`split`) or one list with checkboxes (`single`).
config.fileStatus.view: Show files as a flat list or a folder tree.
config.diff.contextLines: Number of context lines in diffs (0–25).
config.diff.ignoreWhitespace: Ignore whitespace changes in diffs. Line staging is unavailable while this is on.
config.diff.maxLines: Diffs longer than this are collapsed with a "Show all" button.
config.diff.syntaxHighlight: Syntax highlighting in diffs, using the language grammars installed in VS Code and the colors of the current color theme.
config.autoRefresh: Refresh automatically when files or the repository change.
config.autoFetch.intervalMinutes: Fetch remotes periodically while the window is focused. `0` disables it.
config.commit.rememberPushAfter: Remember the "Push immediately" option of the commit box.
config.pullRequests.enabled: Show the pull request linked to each branch (GitHub, GitHub Enterprise Server and Bitbucket Cloud). Public repositories are read without signing in. Private GitHub repositories need a GitHub sign-in in VS Code; private Bitbucket repositories need an Atlassian API token.
config.avatars.enabled: Show author avatars. Sends a hash of the email address to an external service (not implemented yet).
config.customActions: Commands added to the context menu. Variables `${sha}`, `${shortSha}`, `${file}`, `${relFile}`, `${ref}`, `${repo}` are expanded per argument. Can only be set in user settings.
